required.result.win.positive: A genuine YOU WIN final result classifies as FINAL_WIN.
required.result.loss.positive: A genuine YOU LOSE final result classifies as FINAL_LOSS.
required.result.draw.positive: A genuine DRAW result classifies as FINAL_DRAW.
required.result.phase.banner: A PHASE n: YOU WIN / YOU LOSE banner classifies as PHASE.
required.result.clear.gameplay: Bright gameplay classifies as CLEAR, the arming evidence.
required.negative.gameplay: Dark gameplay that is not CLEAR never classifies as a result.
required.negative.false_win: A frame with WIN colours but no result glyphs is not FINAL_WIN.
required.negative.false_draw: A combat frame with neutral-white highlights is not FINAL_DRAW.
required.negative.garage_menu: Garage, menu and rank screens are not results.
required.sequence.repeated_final_screen: A final banner that stays on screen is counted once.
required.sequence.exactly_once: One match produces exactly one accepted result.
required.sequence.post_result_clear: CLEAR during the post-result cooldown is not banked; re-arming needs continuous CLEAR afterwards.
required.sequence.rearm: The detector re-arms for the next match after the post-result CLEAR interval.
required.sequence.next_match: The result of the next match is detected and accepted.
required.sequence.two_match: Two consecutive matches produce two accepted results.
required.sequence.capture_gap: A missing frame breaks consecutive confirmation and is never CLEAR.
required.sequence.discontinuity_identity_change: A capture discontinuity or window identity change drops evidence that belonged to the old capture.
required.sequence.stale_frame: A stale or repeated native capture frame is rejected by the real GameCapture before classification.
required.sequence.dark_gameplay_final_win: Motion-confirmed dark gameplay arms the detector so the following real WIN counts.
required.sequence.startup_visible_final: A final banner already on screen at startup is never counted.
required.contract.draw_no_count: DRAW is detected and reported but never reaches the result gate or the WIN/LOSE counts.
required.contract.gate_feedback: An accepted result returns external_mutation to the detector, installing the post-result lock.
required.contract.undo_feedback: An undo moves the post-result lock to the undo, so the detector re-arms later than it would have without it.
required.contract.gate_rejection: A manual result inside the cooldown is refused by the shared ResultGate and never mutates the detector.
required.contract.processing_time: The post-result cooldown is measured from processing time, not from capture time.
